examples.description: minimal_lmt with its action; the answer is the SignedAuthorization of core vector auth_minimal_lmt_da.
The same request again after the nonce was consumed: the retry rule holds, so 409 carries the stored Authorization.
A commitment whose (agent_pubkey, nonce) registry entry holds another commitment_hash (state assumed): 409 without stored bytes.
minimal_lmt with one action byte flipped: stage A, 422, whether or not the nonce is used.
Wrapper followed by one zero byte: 400.
The node is unreachable: 503, retryable, nothing consumed.
The record request of core receipt vector receipt_minimal_lmt; the answer is that SignedReceipt.
The same record request again: 409 with the stored receipt.
publish_request.json publish_small_blob (the minimal_lmt blob); the answer is response_minimal_lmt.
Quota exhausted: 429, retryable, with a Retry-After header.
Content-Type application/json: 415 before the body is read.
Degraded, Recorder disabled (keys 7 and 8 absent), both DA types allowed.
A v1 envelope on /v0/authorize: the version comes from the signed bytes, so the answer is the Authorization v1 of auth_v1_strict_da.
The same request on the alias /v1/authorize: same handler, same answer.
minimal_lmt (v0) on /v1/authorize at a gate with AcceptV0 false: 403.
v1_pending_blob at a gate whose FastMode is off: 403, nothing written.
